content: The 2014–15 Danish 1st Division was the second tier of professional football in Denmark. It was the 31st season of the Danish 1st Division league. The league was organized by the Danish Football Association. FC Nordsjælland won the league and earned promotion to the Danish Superliga for the 2015–16 season.
